template: RAZ Vue Pro replacement pod in {flavor}. Pre-filled with 5% nicotine; rated on the box for up to 50,000 puffs in Normal mode or 25,000 in Boost mode, with a see-through tank so you can watch the e-liquid level. Fits the RAZ Vue battery (sold in the RAZ Vue kits).

Geek X-Lite disposable vape in {flavor}. Rated for up to 50,000 puffs in Regular mode or 40,000 in Pulse mode (as printed on the box), with a 3D curved screen. Pre-filled with nicotine and rechargeable.

Geek Bar Pulse disposable vape in {flavor}. Up to 15,000 puffs in Regular mode or 7,500 in Pulse mode, with a 16 ml pre-filled tank of 5% nicotine (50 mg/ml), a 650 mAh rechargeable battery (USB-C), a full-color screen showing battery and e-liquid levels, and dual mesh coils.

RAZ RX50K Dew Edition disposable vape, flavor {flavor}. Up to 50,000 puffs from a 19 ml see-through tank of 5% nicotine, with an 800 mAh rechargeable battery (USB-C fast charge), an HD screen showing battery, e-liquid and puff count, three power modes and a dual mesh coil.

RAZ RX50K disposable vape in {flavor}. Up to 50,000 puffs in Normal mode (about 25,000 in Boost) from a 19 ml see-through tank of 5% nicotine, with an 800 mAh rechargeable battery (USB-C fast charge), an HD screen showing battery, e-liquid and puff count, and a dual mesh coil.
